families.title: Game dialogue
families.description: Quest dialogue, branching conversations and barks: lines the player reads or hears in a game, in boxes of limited size and often more than once.

families.title: Instructions and technical docs
families.description: Procedures, how-to steps, troubleshooting and technical documentation read by someone doing a task.

families.title: Academic and professional prose
families.description: Abstracts, papers, reports, proposals, memos and email written to be read and acted on.

families.title: Screen and stage scripts
families.description: Multi-camera and single-camera sitcoms, TV drama and stage plays in script format, timed by the page.

families.title: YouTube scripts
families.description: Narrated video scripts with timestamped segments, written for the ear and the edit.

families.title: Speeches
families.description: Toasts, eulogies, remarks and keynotes, written to be spoken and timed to a target length.

families.title: Poetry and verse forms
families.description: Free verse and the fixed forms: haiku, limerick, ballad, the two sonnets, villanelle and sestina.

families.title: Song lyrics
families.description: Lyrics with labelled sections, matched line lengths, refrains and words set to a melody.
